I just registered for a VEKN number through White Wolf's webpage. It
occurs to me, though, that there are no official VEKN events in Mexico
(at least as far as i know). Having a number and a rating becomes
meaningless, then.

Is there any way that I, and a few like-minded people, could organize
official VEKN tournaments here? I hesitate to ask about this here, but
I reason that the people most likely to be able to help me with this
are almost certain to read this group.

Thanks, and regards,

Messages.Author: Carl Pilhatsch
Messages.Body:
bjorn...@yahoo.com (Sigmund Bjornstein) wrote in message news:<9e226d99.01052...@posting.google.com>...

> Is there any way that I, and a few like-minded people, could organize
> official VEKN tournaments here? I hesitate to ask about this here, but
> I reason that the people most likely to be able to help me with this
> are almost certain to read this group.

The Prince-list on WW's homepage shows the contact persons in each
city. If a given city doesn't list a VEKN Prince, then the job is most
likely vacant, and any player can apply for it. Instructions on how to
do this are given at the HP, but as I'm in charge of appointing VEKN
Princes just e-mail me at carl.pi...@chello.at

Of course, anyone can organize a tournament, but only VEKN Princes can
organize sanctioned official VEKN tournaments with prize support.
I hope this answered your question.

Carl Pilhatsch
(VEKN membership director)
